questions.q: On the morning of the resurrection, how was the massive stone removed from the entrance of Jesus' tomb? (Matthew 28:2)
options: The Roman soldiers rolled it away.
A severe earthquake occurred, and an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and rolled back the stone.
Peter and John pushed it open using heavy wooden levers.
Mary Magdalene enlisted the help of the temple guards.
questions.explain: Matthew 28:2 describes the supernatural event: "And behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and came and rolled back the stone and sat on it."
